name: United Purification Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: United Purification Technology Co., Ltd. provides end-to-end water treatment solutions, encompassing design, planning, development, assembly, installation, upkeep, and sales of advanced purification systems. Established in 1987 and based in Taichung, Taiwan, the company caters to a diverse range of high-demand industrial sectors. Its clientele includes semiconductor fabricators and other electronics manufacturers, as well as facilities in petrochemicals, cogeneration power, specialized semiconductor-grade chemical production, biotechnology, and pharmaceuticals.
